description: All-in-one desktop download manager for courses, videos, music, and 1,800+ websites, with built-in media and study tools.
notes: Uses the upstream standalone Windows portable executable, not the NSIS setup installer or MSI package.
Creates portable.txt beside the executable so settings, databases, cookies, plugins, caches, downloader tools, and WebView2 data are stored in the persisted data directory.
The app supports in-place portable self-updates. Prefer updating through Scoop so the installed version metadata remains synchronized.
pre_install: if ($null -eq $portableExe) { throw 'OmniGet portable executable was not found.' }
